defectsFound.description: _handle_create_activity_event used keyword argument 'metadata=' but ActivityEvent model has 'payload=' (JSONField). Would raise TypeError at runtime for any create_activity_event action.
_handle_create_activity_event passed 'occurred_at' to a field declared auto_now_add=True. Removed the redundant argument and the now-unused 'from datetime import datetime, timezone' import.

check_invoice_overdue_rules guarded with hasattr(invoice, 'project_id') which always evaluates True. When project FK is NULL, str(None) produced the string 'None' instead of JSON null. Fixed to: str(invoice.project_id) if invoice.project_id else None.

AutomationRule.trigger_type and AutomationRule.is_enabled lacked db_index=True. These columns are used in every fire_trigger query (filter by both). Added db_index=True to both fields; migration 0002_add_rule_indexes created and applied.

findings.notes: All five AutomationRule/Condition/Action/Run/RunLog viewsets require IsStaffUser (authenticated + is_staff=True). No unauthenticated endpoint exists.
All repository queries use Django ORM queryset methods (filter, get, update_or_create). No raw SQL anywhere in the bounded context.
fire_trigger validates trigger_type against the TriggerType enum before dispatching; invalid values are rejected with a warning log and early return.
Django-Q2 tasks dispatched via string path ('apps.workflow_automation.tasks.execute_automation_rule'), not direct callable references. Avoids circular imports and limits deserialization surface.
SendGrid API key, Twilio credentials accessed via django.conf.settings only. No secrets in source files.
ActivityEvent.objects.create uses lazy import inside handler function body - no framework-level permission bypass. Write is intentional automation output, not a user-facing endpoint.

deliverable.approved: fire_trigger called AFTER use_case.execute (approval saved first). metric.threshold_crossed: fire_trigger called per triggered alert in evaluate_alert_rules after alerts are persisted.
Both filter columns now have db_index=True via migration 0002_add_rule_indexes.
Same indexed columns - covered by the migration above.

findings.query: AutomationRun / AutomationRunLog queries filtered by rule_id / run_id
findings.notes: rule and run are ForeignKey fields; Django creates DB indexes on FK columns automatically.

performanceSummary.baseline: Portfolio-scale workload; no load testing performed. Index coverage is sufficient for expected traffic.

knownLimitationsLog.description: AutomationNewPage multi-step form submits rule then conditions/actions as separate POST requests. If a condition/action POST fails, the rule is left in a partial state. Bulk-create endpoint deferred to future sprint (KI-3).

Integration tests for DjangoAutomationRuleRepository and DjangoAutomationRunRepository are not yet written. Infrastructure correctness confirmed by code review of mapper patterns (same approach as client_portal which has integration coverage).
